work.description: The act reviews and condemns the chief errors of the age before the assembled bishops. Issuer evidence: the volume title PII IX. — PONTIFICIS MAXIMI ACTA (LF131-135) as pontificate-section heading. Dating LF17188-17188 reads: HABITA IN CONSISTORIO DIE IX IVNLE MDCCCLIII. Date note: Edition dated caption Habita in consistorio ..., retained in the selection; it is the only printed dating of the speech. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
